content.comment_body: Hello, I've been experiencing frequent spinning ball freezes on MacOS Mojave when using [product_name] [version_no]. The application completely stops responding, especially when I try to use on/off delay functions. Is anyone else facing similar issues with Mojave and [product_name] [version_no]? Is there any news about a potential update? Would appreciate any guidance. P.S.: I am using the latest Java version. Update: I'm encountering problems with all delay function blocks.

Hi, [product_name] has not been officially released for Mojave. Here are the supported MacOS versions: • Mac OS X 10.7 Lion • Mac OS X 10.8 Mountain Lion • Mac OS X 10.9 Mavericks • Mac OS X 10.10 Yosemite • Mac OS X 10.11 El Capitan That's a common issue with software - by the time it gets released, a new operating system is already available. Hope this clarifies things.

Thank you for your response. On MacOS High Sierra, [product_name] performed well. It's unfortunate that it doesn't work on Mojave, and I hope an update comes soon. For now, I'll use a Windows virtual machine until this issue is resolved.
After updating to Mojave 10.14.1 today, the spinning ball problem disappeared. [version_no] now works well with Mojave.
It’s still not working for me with Mojave 10.14.4.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing frequent application freezes and a persistent spinning ball issue when using delay block functionalities in [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS Mojave. The problem appears linked to OS compatibility, since it did not occur on older MacOS versions like High Sierra. While some users noticed improvements after updating Mojave to a newer patch, others continue to experience the issue. The lack of consistent support and timely software updates has led to user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to function reliably and be updated promptly to support the latest MacOS versions.
